concept.reason: Original fossil photograph, labeled osteological and soft-tissue drawing and life-skeleton drawing visually inspected; adequate without extra concept generation.

scope: Complete furred semiaquatic mammaliaform, with broad dorsoventrally flattened tail and swimming-adapted limbs, based on holotype JZMP04-117.

scientific_limits.en: Holotype JZMP04-117 is a compressed partial skeleton with incomplete cranium and preserved fur and tail scales. Complete living volume, ears, color and fleshed proportions are reconstructions. Hindfoot webbing is suggested by soft-tissue traces, not an entirely preserved paddle. Body mass 500-800 g is an estimate. Flattened tail is not proof of identity with modern beaver anatomy.
scientific_limits.zh: 正模JZMP04-117为压扁的不完整骨架，颅骨不全，保存毛与尾部鳞痕。完整活体体积、耳、颜色及软组织比例属于复原；后足蹼由软组织残迹支持，不是完整保存的鳍。500至800克体重为估计，不可照搬现代海狸解剖。

classification: Docodonta, Mammaliaformes; not a rodent or a crown-group monotreme

scale.measurement_status: Published preserved dimensions of partial holotype; neither is a complete living-animal measurement.
scale.live_dimensions_status: Explicit original reconstruction estimates guided by original Fig1 drawing, not additional fossil measurements. Tail fur outline in source at least50 percent wider than pelvic width; preserve broad paddle outline.

diagnostic_targets: Complete low-slung furred animal with elongate narrow pointed snout and small inferred ears, not a duck bill or beaver incisors.
Broad elongated paddle tail compressed dorsoventrally: wide in top view, thin in side view; maximum width clearly exceeds pelvis. Tail is not vertically flattened or cylindrical otter tail.
Furred trunk with robust short outward-set forelimbs, visibly separate feet and modest claws, not seal flippers.
Spread hind toes linked by conservative partial webbing; retain toe silhouettes rather than solid oval feet.
Tail base furry, middle mostly fine scaled surface with sparse hair, distal margin some hair; simplify scales without literal large armored plates.
Semi-sprawling quadrupedal posture, coherent neck and limb joints; neutral original brown coloration not asserted fossil pigment.
acceptance: Retain original whole-animal scope and both broad tail and swimming limb diagnostic gates.
Top view clearly shows tail wider than pelvic region; side view shows flat thin tail, never upright beaver disk.
Front/perspective distinguish four separate limbs and the splayed hindfoot webbing from amorphous lumps.
Head remains pointed mammaliaform, with no platypus bill or oversized modern rodent incisors.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds and independent review required.
